props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The id of the DOM node that describes the switch

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the DOM node that labels the switch

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Uncontrolled - whether the switch is turned on

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the switch is ready for user input

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the switch's value is being calculated

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the switch is turned on

props.name: onChange
props.description: The callback that is called when the switch is toggled on or off

props.name: onClick
props.description: The callback that is called when the switch is clicked

props.name: statusLabelPosition
props.description:
Whether the "on" and "off" labels should appear before or after the switch.

**This should only be changed when the switch's alignment needs to be adjusted.** For example: It needs to be left-aligned because the label appears above it and the caption appears below it.

props.name: loadingLabelDelay
props.description: When the switch is in the loading state, this value controls the amount of delay in milliseconds before the word "Loading" is announced to screen readers.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: The text that is announced to AT such as screen readers when the switch is in a loading state.

props.name: buttonType
props.description: As it’s part of form behavior, this controls whether the button is of type `button`, `submit`, or `reset`.

props.name: buttonLabelOn
props.description: The text to display when the toggle switch is turned on. Only customize this label if there is a more specific label for the context. For example, you might use 'Show' if the setting is 'Show images'.

props.name: buttonLabelOff
props.description: The text to display when the toggle switch is turned off. Only customize this label if there is a more specific label for the context. For example, you might use 'Hide' if the setting is 'Show images'.
